name: Line carries the colour
look: A section that sits on a new ground rises into the screen covered by the old ground; a one-pixel accent line climbs through it from its foot to its top and takes the cover with it: below the line the section's own ground and words, above it the old ground.
reduced: The section stands on its own ground, no cover, no line.
phone: The section stands on its own ground, no cover, no line.

needs.grounds: the section sits on another ground than the one before it (ground-inverse, ground-surface)
needs.words: a section of one or two screens with its h2 first
